title: N-gram Next-Word Predictor from Scratch
description: Counts word sequences in a small text corpus and predicts the next word with smoothing, then shows how model order and smoothing change both accuracy and the fluency of generated sentences.

title: Regular-Expression Toolkit for Extracting Dates, Phones and Emails
description: Builds and tests a library of patterns for common contact details across several formats, with a labelled test set that shows exactly which inputs each pattern misses or wrongly accepts.

title: Word Frequency and Zipf's Law Explorer
description: Counts words in several books, plots rank against frequency on log scales and shows how closely each text follows Zipf's law, comparing languages and genres. Includes a short write-up on where the law breaks down and why.

title: Sentiment Lexicon Builder for a Niche Domain
description: Grows a domain-specific sentiment word list from a few seed words by propagating through word embeddings, and checks the lexicon against labelled reviews from that domain versus a generic list.

title: Legal Plain-Language Rewriter with Readability Gates
description: Rewrites dense clauses into shorter plain English with a language model, then rejects any rewrite that drops a defined term, number or negation, using automated checks before a human sees it.

title: Named Entity Recognition for Kitchen Recipes
description: Tags quantities, units, ingredients and cooking actions in recipe steps by training a sequence labeller on a hand-annotated sample, reporting per-entity scores and the most confusing cases.

title: Search Engine over a Local Document Folder in Java
description: Indexes text and PDF files in a folder, supports phrase and fuzzy queries with ranked results and highlights, and measures query latency as the folder grows to tens of thousands of files.

title: Accent-Robust Command Recognition Dataset Study
description: Collects and evaluates spoken command recordings across several accent groups, measures error rates per group with a speech model, and tests simple augmentation that narrows the gap.

title: Tokenisation Comparison Lab across Languages
description: Compares whitespace, rule-based and subword tokenisers on English, German and a morphologically rich language, reporting vocabulary size, out-of-vocabulary rate and effect on a downstream classifier.

title: Topic Drift Tracker for Long-Running Forum Threads
description: Monitors how the subject of a discussion thread moves over time using sliding-window topic vectors, flags threads that wander off topic and evaluates alerts against moderator judgments.
